_note: REACHED LIVE at 1440x900: Insert's Text row creates a text element and
selects it, which is the production path into the TEXT profile. Measured in
the shell rather than the board's 300 frame — the app has no view that shows
the inspector alone.
This board and its five siblings (807:8412 FLEX, :8475 GRID, :8521 MEDIA,
:8567 BUTTON, :8614 INPUT) share one section chassis, so most of what was
fixed here is fixed for all six. In board order:
SECTION HEADERS were 28 tall whether open or shut, and the board draws 20
open / 28 shut (2069:20295 against 2069:20308..20317) — a title belongs to
the rows under it once they are showing. Their height is also PINNED now
rather than left to padding: BACKGROUND measured 30 because its `+` action
is 18px and the row grew around it.
the row carries `--color/ink-muted` on the BOARD, and did not here — the
label and chevron were muted individually while the row sat on the panel's
ink, so anything else added to a header would have arrived dark.
the section label's tracking, 0.06em -> 0.08em (the board's 0.88px at 11).
SECTION BODY padding 2/10 -> 0/8, which is what makes the boards' arithmetic
come out: header 20, rows 34 each, 8 of air, next header. The boards draw
the LAST row of a section 42 rather than 34 for exactly this reason.
THE FAMILY ROW was the only control in the panel with its own chrome —
white on `--bk-border-medium`, radius 6, plus a 12px bottom margin that
broke the 34 rhythm. 807:8352 draws it as the same gray-50/gray-100/radius-4
frame as every other control, and it now uses the shared `.bdi-ddn`.
THE COLOUR ROW measured 127 wide against the board's 160, because a second
chip sat outside the field repeating the hex the field already shows. The
chip is now drawn only when the value is BOUND, where it carries a token
name the field cannot — which is also the only state board 32:2 draws it in
segmented tracks 24 -> 28, the height of every other control on the board.
three new anchors, because the boards draw three boxes per row and only two
had one: `inspector-label-<slug>` joins the 12/normal ink-soft label at x16
(807:8351 …). `inspector-row-size` and `inspector-field-<slug>` on the
segmented rows came with it.
NOT JOINED, and why:
807:8343, the header's `--flowbite/gray/50` fill. CENSUSED across every
committed spec: 37 boards draw this 48h row with NO fill (32:3, 642:3251,
159:3, 200:100, 301:2082, the whole S5 family …), 6 draw it gray-50 — the
six profile boards — and 1 (160:314, pseudo-state) draws it accent-tinted.
White ships. An inspector header that changed colour with the selection
would be a defect, not conformance. The media recipe reached the same
verdict from a 2-1 count; this is the whole count.
956:4475, the context strip at 40 tall. Same census: 38 boards draw it 32
the six profile boards. 32 ships. It is one strip, not a per-profile one.
807:8344, the 38x22 accent-tint chip reading the PROFILE name ('Text').
32:2 and 642:3112 put the ELEMENT's own name there and so does live. A
person selects a heading, not a profile.
807:8370 / 807:8373 (Transform, Decoration) and the Align row's control.
The board draws each as a value frame showing 'none' / 'left'; the product
ships a segmented control, which is a control-type difference rather than a
fill one — its track is `--bk-bg-subtle` on purpose, because the white
ACTIVE chip inside it has nothing to stand out of on gray-50. Their ROWS
and LABELS are joined and match, so the row geometry is still measured.
2069:20304 / 2069:20307, the 42-tall last row of a section. The 8 extra is
trailing air, and in the DOM it is the section body's own padding-bottom
(now 8) rather than part of the row box. Same pixels, different owner.
807:8411's COLOUR, and this one is a contrast refusal, said loudly:
the board sets the 'N of 11 sections apply' footer in
`--color/ink-placeholder` #9CA3AF. On the panel's white that is 2.54:1 at
11px, against a 4.5 floor — not a marginal miss, a third of the required
ratio. It ships `--bk-ink-muted` (4.83:1). Its size and line box are joined
and match; only the colour is withheld.
